This role requires a hands-on security engineer with broad experience across endpoint, network, cloud, application, identity, and data security. The engineer will serve as a technical authority for assigned security platforms, help define engineering standards and architecture, lead complex implementations and migrations, troubleshoot escalated security issues, and work closely with Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Application, and other technology teams. Engineer and support endpoint detection and response (EDR) controls across workstation and server environments. Maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) and endpoint security capabilities, including device configuration, security baselines, encryption, compliance, and protection policies. Develop automation to improve provisioning, configuration management, evidence collection, monitoring, incident response, and other repeatable security engineering activities. Establish and maintain security configuration standards and hardening baselines using recognized industry frameworks and vendor-recommended security guidance. Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and decommission/runbook documentation to ensure security capabilities are scalable and supportable. Participate in incident response activities by providing engineering expertise, technical analysis, containment support, and remediation guidance. Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes, consolidate security capabilities, improve control effectiveness, and strengthen the overall security architecture. Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux security and enterprise infrastructure. Experience with security hardening and configuration standards using frameworks such as CIS Controls/CIS Benchmarks and NIST guidance. Experience with scripting or automation using PowerShell, Python, APIs, or comparable technologies. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyze complex security and infrastructure problems across multiple technology layers. Ability to assess technical risk and translate security requirements into practical engineering solutions. Ability to independently manage engineering initiatives from requirements and design through implementation, documentation, and operational transition. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, security leadership, business stakeholders, and third-party service providers. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in a regulated enterprise environment such as insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another industry with significant security and compliance requirements. Experience leading enterprise security platform migrations, implementations, or modernization efforts. Understanding of modern application and API security architectures. Experience with hybrid environments spanning traditional data centers, cloud infrastructure, SaaS platforms, and remote users. review_candidates.description: Description Invent the future with us. Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing by developing SoCs and platform solutions focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable AI compute for cloud, edge, and physical applications. AI is showing up in essentially every part of the technology landscape, and we’re focused on delivering the performance, efficiency, and reliability those workloads require. Ampere is building compute silicon and platforms for AI applications spanning a broad range of industries. We focus on solving exciting challenges in areas such as robotics and automotive, among others, but the core of our work is enabling efficient AI at scale and across multiple application domains. Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply! About the Role: Ampere Computing's Information Security team is expanding its technical capabilities and seeking a hands-on Information Security Engineer to join a dynamic, mission-driven security engineering team dedicated to protecting next-generation computing infrastructure. In this role, your daily focus will center on hands-on administration, research, implementation, upgrades, and continuous improvement across our enterprise and cloud security tech stack. Reporting to the Sr. Director, Information Security, you will collaborate with fellow security engineers to evaluate emerging tools, deploy and harden platforms, suppress false positives through active tuning, elevate high-fidelity threat indicators, and maintain operational dashboards reflecting real-time environment posture. This role actively supports Security Operations workflows on alert escalations, correlation logic refinement, and incident response activities. Additionally, the Information Security Engineer collaborates cross-functionally with IT, Infrastructure, Engineering, and corporate partners—including People & Culture (P&C) and Legal—to support joint initiatives. What You’ll Achieve: Security Platform Administration & Engineering: Partner with the team to administer, configure, upgrade, and maintain Ampere's growing suite of enterprise security solutions—spanning Endpoint Detection & Response (e.g., CrowdStrike, SentinelOne), Vulnerability Management (e.g., Qualys), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and Identity Governance (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID)—while actively researching, evaluating, and onboarding new security technologies as organizational needs expand. Detection Engineering & Alert Tuning: Continuously evaluate detection rule efficacy across systems; proactively tune out low-significance alerts and false positives to ensure high-fidelity threat detection and reduce operational noise. Vulnerability Remediation & Zero-Day Response: Partner cross-functionally with IT, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to prioritize and drive remediation campaigns for identified vulnerabilities, urgent zero-day threats, and out-of-cycle patching. Security Hardening, Baselines & Privilege Management: Collaborate on foundational security engineering initiatives—including defining and enforcing systems baseline hardening standards (e.g., CIS benchmarks, OS and image baselines) across servers, endpoints, and cloud instances; operationalizing least-privilege access models; securing secrets and credential management; and mitigating privilege escalation paths. Security Operations Support & Incident Escalation: Support Security Operations workflows by investigating escalated alerts, refining detection correlation logic, and participating directly in security incident triage, containment, and post-incident reviews. SOAR Playbook Automation: Maintain, optimize, and build automated playbooks within enterprise SIEM and SOAR platforms to streamline alert triage, enrich investigative context, and automate routine operational containment workflows. Cloud & Identity Security Posture: Support the management and configuration of cloud security monitoring and posture controls across multi-cloud environments (AWS IAM, GCP Security Command Center, Azure/OCI), enforcing least-privilege principles and baseline hardening. Metrics, Telemetry & Dashboarding: Develop and maintain operational dashboards and key risk indicators (KRIs) that provide clear visibility into endpoint agent coverage, vulnerability aging, system hygiene, and tool operational status. Cross-Functional Advisory & Exception Governance: Serve as a collaborative security partner to IT, DevOps, and Engineering; evaluate security exception requests, review architectural changes, and deliver practical, risk-aware security consultations. About You: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 5 yearsof dedicated experience in security engineering, security operations (SecOps), or detection & response engineering. Experience deploying and managing modern EDR/XDR platforms (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne), vulnerability scanners (e.g., Qualys), and enterprise SIEM/SOAR platforms. Deep technical familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID and major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI).
